scope: research tools only; 12 candidate variants; source/public game unchanged

definitions.injured: at least one non-blunt wound in one scripted trial
definitions.liveCuts: non-blunt wound events; multiple zones per impact possible
definitions.liveDamage: false disables defender wounds only; bouts stop when either fighter dies
definitions.earlyEnd: 120-second live bouts may end early when the attacker dies; paired durations are exposed
definitions.oracle: uses trial wall time; diagnostic only, not an implementable reader
definitions.validation: E2 was chosen after E results; seeds 1–15 are no longer independent for E2; E2 independent seeds16–20, only 4 activations in wound-disabled fights and zero with wounds enabled
